notes.title: Save and UI update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40172147/e0ad6f5531bb437874ffe1e9d81d5bc33fe37745.png[/img]
Ahoyhoy Epic Plasma Gamers! We've recently decided to revisit Little Shell's Adventure and bring you a brand new update fixing a lot of issues with the previous version. The main updates are to the saving system and the UI. Stay tuned for updates as there are some big things coming. If you had a previously broken save, it will work now! We sure appreciate all 82 of you!

tags.bug: If you had a previously broken save, it will work now!

notes.title: Roguelike Mode
notes.content:
[h1]Update 1.1:[/h1]
Ahoy hoy everyone! Thanks for purchasing Little Shell's Adventure and hopefully enjoying it! As promised, we will be releasing content 
updates every so often building off of what is already in the game. For today, we've added in a Roguelike mode that is accessible after
beating the game. So if you want more content, there is a theoretical infinite amount of it ready to be played!
We appreciate everybody being patient with the bugs that we've been patching since release, we are a small team and we hope that it
hasn't negatively impacted you're experience playing the game.
Here are the full patch notes of this patch:

[h2]FIXED:[/h2]
Selected sword not saving between scenes.
Archie will come back after receiving the sword (kinda creepy)
The heart collection achievement is now obtainable
The Shell Spin achievement is now obtainable
Buying items now gives the applicable achievement.
Forging Crab Armor now gives the achievement.
Title screen movement speed.
Several issues with audio.
Certain skins not being obtainable after purchase.
Certain campfires incorrectly saving.

[h2]ADDED:[/h2]
A Roguelike mode that you can access once you've beaten the game.
Tips around the world giving more information about controls.

[h2]CHANGED:[/h2]
Minor dialogue between certain characters.
The decoration of Little Shell's house.
The decoration and theme of several shops across box island.
Controls to make it more controller friendly.
